picker.note: This is only about style — the look and feel of your app. It isn't every page we'll build. Want to see a particular page or feature? Just tell me.

help.title: What is this page?
help.p1: You're choosing how your app will <1>look</1>. This page shows an example app in a few different styles — the screens and content are just samples, not your real app.
help.p2: <0>Flip through the looks</0> with the buttons at the bottom, and use the phone and computer buttons to see how each one feels at both widths.
help.p3: When one feels right, just tell me its name — like <1>"I like Bold"</1> — and I'll build your app in that style.
help.p4: Nothing has to be perfect here. You can also ask me to <1>tweak a look</1> — <3>"Playful, but with blue instead of pink"</3> — or to <5>show you more choices</5> if none of these feel right.
